primary_object_card.object_statement: The z3/cvc5 tool-depth repair proves row-derived finite coverage, downstream-lock, and order-sensitivity claims with non-vacuous SAT, UNSAT, and boundary controls before solver rows can support the layer-lego factory.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The multimodel audit names z3/cvc5 map_unprovable rows and metadata-only ablations as the next bounded repair before deeper tool claims.
The parent breadth receipt has 44 layer rows, 48 G-structure rows, 15 tool rows, 8/16/32/64 site coverage, and blocked downstream consumers.
Tool-stage work must be micro-first with one tool/function claim, positive, negative, boundary behavior, demotion condition, and no downstream promotion.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object to preserve is the proof-tool repair itself: z3 and cvc5 must each act on row-derived finite facts from the existing layer/G/tool breadth receipt, and they must both show positive SAT, negative UNSAT, boundary SAT, and order-cycle UNSAT behavior. This packet prevents a solver label, an import, or a metadata ablation row from becoming proof depth.

native_terms.row-derived finite facts: The exact layer rows, G-structure rows, tool rows, site counts, bond bounds, metric floors, and locked-consumer facts read from the parent result rather than invented constants.
native_terms.map_unprovable: A demotion outcome meaning that without a proof solver's actual formula result, the map cannot be certified; it is not a passing proof by itself.
native_terms.non-vacuous solver control: A solver check that has at least one expected SAT case, one expected UNSAT case, one boundary mutation that changes status, and one demotion path if the solver is removed.
native_terms.order-cycle control: The N01 guard where Omega_r, compatibility weights, adapters, compression, rho_present, and outward_record must keep order; forcing a cycle must be UNSAT.

weirdness_signature: solver import or solver label is not proof depth
metadata ablation text cannot become non-vacuous ablation evidence
the repair is tool-depth only and cannot select G-structure or open stacking
positive and negative solver controls must be over the same row-derived formula family
primary_object_card.domain: the existing tool-by-tool layer/G-structure breadth receipt plus the v4.3 layer-factory and RPF object packets
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: a bounded solver-depth repair receipt with z3/cvc5 status matrix, formula hashes, models or unsat cores, ablation deltas, and locked downstream consumers
allowed_operations: encode the same finite formula family in z3 and cvc5
run positive SAT, negative UNSAT, boundary SAT, and order-cycle UNSAT controls
record formula hashes, SAT models, UNSAT cores, and solver agreement
demote the claim if a solver is removed or if statuses disagree
required_invariants: row facts come from the parent result, not from detached constants
z3 and cvc5 check the same formula names and expectations
boundary mutation changes the satisfiability status
downstream consumers remain blocked after the repair
forbidden_substitutions: proxy SAT label without formula hash
stacking or Axis0 continuation from solver repair
negative_controls: actual rows plus violation target is UNSAT
one synthetic failed row plus violation target is SAT
valid object order chain is SAT
downstream consumer opening blocks the packet
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The solver-control packet is a proof-tool adapter for the layer-lego factory. It may repair z3/cvc5 depth, but it cannot become layer evidence, G-structure selection, stacking, Axis0, FEP, physics, or final manifold proof.
promotion_locks: official G-structure selection cannot be opened

lateral_mappings.label: SMT proof-tool adapter
lateral_mappings.target: row-derived finite coverage and order-control formula family
preserves: finite row IDs and pass facts
loses: right to select G-structure or stacking order
preconditions: parent result exists and all row facts are read
both solvers run the same named formula family
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If z3 or cvc5 is removed, or if either solver returns a different expected status, the solver-depth repair is blocked.

lateral_mappings.label: Torch finite carrier witness
lateral_mappings.target: nonclassical carrier witness for the repair packet
preconditions: parent result exposes count and metric floors
gradient is nonzero under the finite carrier witness
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If the torch witness or gradient is removed, the packet cannot claim nonclassical carrier support.

lateral_mappings.label: Solver-status summary
lateral_mappings.target: compact status table for the five formula expectations
preserves: which solver returned SAT or UNSAT
preconditions: full formula matrix remains stored in the result receipt
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If only the compact status table remains and the formula matrix is absent, the packet is downgraded to summary-only.

extended_constraints: formula hashes, SAT models, and UNSAT cores

fixation_breakers: if the packet starts optimizing a solver label, require formula hash and boundary mutation
if a summary table is treated as proof, reopen the row-level formula matrix
if downstream work is suggested, block it unless the layer factory matrix is exhausted

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first solver non-vacuity failure before adding new layer, G-structure, stacking, Axis0, flux, FEP, or physics work
loop_contract.stop_condition: z3 and cvc5 both pass the expected SAT/UNSAT matrix and status artifacts name the next independent tool-depth packet, or a blocker names the first formula that failed
